explanation: The evidence describes palbociclib only as 'an inhibitor of CDK4/6'; none of the cited or dossier evidence states it is 'selective,' 'oral,' or 'reversible,' so these specific descriptors lack support in the shown evidence.
suggested_rewrite: Palbociclib is an inhibitor of cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6); cyclin D1 and CDK4/6 lie downstream of proliferative signaling pathways, and inhibition blocks Rb phosphorylation, arresting cells in G1 phase.
